## How exposed is AdventHealth to CMS TEAM?

<BlogFastFacts label={"Fast Facts — AdventHealth & TEAM"} items={["~16 name-matched TEAM hospitals (approx.)","Core geography: Florida TEAM CBSAs + Sun Belt adjacency","Strategic edge: ambulatory + faith-based PAC relationships","Florida has 40 TEAM hospitals total — AdventHealth is a major but not exclusive player","Reminder: Miami is largely outside TEAM selection"]} />

Name matching on the March 2026 roster finds approximately **16 AdventHealth** TEAM hospitals — third behind HCA-family and Kaiser clusters. Florida TEAM CBSAs (Jacksonville, Daytona/Deltona, Lakeland, Fort Walton, and others) are the operational center of gravity; additional Sun Belt sites extend the pattern.

AdventHealth’s ambulatory footprint matters for TEAM: LEJR profitability correlates with **home-first discharge** supported by outpatient therapy access. Systems that already own or tightly affiliate those nodes spend less time begging for home-health starts on postoperative day one.

## What should competing Florida and Sun Belt hospitals watch?

Watch AdventHealth’s **preferred PAC and home-health patterns** in Jacksonville and Central Florida CBSAs. If your orthopedic patients flow into the same SNFs, you inherit their length-of-stay culture unless you intervene with contracts and on-site case management.

Use the [Florida TEAM hospital directory](/cms-team/participating-hospitals/florida/) for the full hospital list, the [South region hub](/cms-team/participating-hospitals/region/south/) for regional context, and the HCA guide for the other multi-site for-profit competitor in overlapping markets.

## What is the AdventHealth-relevant prep checklist?

1. Confirm which of your CBSAs are actually in TEAM (Florida is not uniform).
2. Benchmark LEJR home-discharge rates against AdventHealth peers in-market.
3. Negotiate dual-access agreements with high-volume SNFs.
4. Stand up fracture and spine episode huddles — not LEJR-only dashboards.

## Frequently asked questions

### How many AdventHealth hospitals are in CMS TEAM?

About 16 TEAM hospitals match AdventHealth naming on Rainfall’s March 2026 directory — verify each CCN for contracting.

### Is AdventHealth only a Florida TEAM story?

Florida is the core, but Sun Belt adjacency matters. Always check the CBSA-level roster rather than assuming statewide inclusion.

### Who else should Florida TEAM hospitals study?

HCA’s Florida footprint and the [Florida TEAM hospital directory](/cms-team/participating-hospitals/florida/) — multi-site competition is the defining TEAM dynamic in several FL CBSAs.
